verdicts_or_reports.expected: Amaze retains Grid and Alpha retains List independently, including rotation.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After setting Amaze Grid and Alpha List, rotating in Alpha resets Amaze to List. Setting Amaze Grid again also makes Alpha open as Grid until rotation. Reproduced twice.
steps: Open AndroidQA/Amaze and select Grid View.
Open Alpha and select List View.
Back to Amaze: Grid initially retained.
Reopen Alpha, rotate landscape then portrait, Back to Amaze: now List.
Set Amaze Grid again and open Alpha: Alpha now Grid; rotate and return: Amaze List again.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Rename creates a uniquely named copy of Alpha containing readme.txt.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: RENAME dismisses conflict but no new folder appears, even after leaving and returning. Repeated twice.
steps: In AndroidQA/Amaze tap Alpha Properties menu > Copy.
Tap PASTE in same folder.
Conflict says Alpha; tap RENAME.
Wait, enter Beta then Back: still only Alpha and Beta.
Repeat copy/paste/RENAME: same result.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Copied Alpha/readme.txt retains source's 13 B contents.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Both independent copies of Alpha into Beta contain readme.txt of 0 B. First copy was renamed Alpha copy+; second fresh copy also 0 B.
steps: In Amaze copy Alpha via its Properties menu.
Open Beta and PASTE.
Open Beta/Alpha: readme.txt is 0 B (source Alpha/readme.txt was 13 B).
Rename copied folder to Alpha copy+.
Return to Amaze, copy original Alpha again, paste into Beta.
Open new Beta/Alpha: readme.txt again 0 B.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Beta precedes Alpha because Beta was added first.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Drawer lists Alpha above Beta, alphabetically rather than addition order. Deleted both and repeated Beta then Alpha with identical result; screenshot verified.
steps: Starting without bookmarks, in Amaze use Beta menu > Add to Bookmarks.
Use Alpha menu > Add to Bookmarks.
Open drawer: Alpha above Beta.
Delete both using drawer pencil > DELETE.
Repeat adding Beta then Alpha: Alpha still above Beta.

verdicts_or_reports.observed: Added Alpha and Beta visible before rotation; after landscape and portrait both vanish from drawer.
steps: In Amaze add Beta then Alpha to bookmarks via folder menus.
Open drawer and verify Alpha and Beta entries.
Navigate through Alpha bookmark; open drawer.
Rotate landscape then portrait.
Open drawer: both added bookmarks are missing.
